Wall/step-count knobs (naf_per_scene_s/naf_outer_wall_s) held constant for lineage comparability — out-of-protocol to change. FAILURE MODE: per-scene NeRF attenuation field is REGIME-BOUNDED on dense 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete → hr structurally 0 vs ~0.81 cal floor); hash payoff lives in the 128-view sparse regime. PREDICT SSIM ~0.696 (genuine 0.693-0.697 noise band; ignore any throughput-driven 0.72-0.74 outlier), hr 0, elapsed ~1095-1108s, params 33.56M.
